description: Call by name, no HS code needed: returns one named indicator as a series (monthly or quarterly, newest first) with its latest value, year-on-year changes, a partner-country breakdown where the indicator has one, the definition, the caveats and a fixed notice that the value is our own calculation and not an official figure. Give an id or an English or Japanese alias (a few distinctive words also work when they match one indicator); list_indicators shows what exists. Use it to read an indicator by name; use get_series instead for one HS code. An indicator that cannot be computed yet is answered with status not_computable or not_built and the reason, never with zeros. Naphtha prices state their quantity basis: kL read directly from the source, or (only as a fallback) an estimate under a stated density assumption.

country.description: Optional, only for indicators with a partner-country breakdown. Partner country as an ISO 3166 alpha-2 code (e.g. "CN") or the name as published; the answer then holds the monthly series of that partner.

from.description: Optional. First month, formatted YYYY-MM, or a year YYYY (the whole year from January).

indicator.description: Required. The indicator id (for example "jp.naphtha.domestic_base_price"), an alias in English or Japanese, or a few distinctive words. See list_indicators.

limit.description: Optional. Number of newest rows (months, or quarters for a quarterly indicator) to return; default 36, at most 200.

to.description: Optional. Last month, formatted YYYY-MM, or a year YYYY (the whole year to December).

name: get_indicator
